title: 第二十九章清理
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
雷劫地里一片死寂。

    只有地缝里那些银白电光，还在不知疲倦的游走，发出噼啪声。

    王师兄瘫在碎石堆里，浑身瘫软。

    他瞪着自己那条软绵垂落的胳膊，从手腕到肩膀已经不成形状，骨头碴子混着血肉戳破了皮。

    剧痛后知后觉的涌上大脑，他张着嘴，喉咙里发出嗬的漏风声，一个字都喊不出来。

    他不信。

    就在刚才，这个人还被他锻体圆满的气血压的腿软，一副随时要跪地求饶的怂样。

    那孱弱的锻体四阶气息，他探查的清楚楚，绝不可能作假。

    可就是这么个废物，迎着他全力一拳，只用了一掌。

    一掌，就把他这条淬炼多年的体修臂膀，从头到尾砸了个稀烂。

    “不……不可能……”

    王师兄从喉咙里挤出几个字，声音抖的不成调。

    叶凡没理会他的嘶吼。

    他身形一晃，疾风飘叶步法用出，人已经悄无声息的，贴着焦土飘到了王师兄面前。

    快的让王师兄瞳孔骤然一缩。

    “你——”

    王师兄刚想挣扎着起身，一只脚已经踩在他完好的那条腿的膝盖上。

    咔嚓。

    又是一声让人牙酸的脆响。

    王师兄的惨叫刚冲到一半，就被剧痛憋了回去，整个人弓起背。

    叶凡抬起拳头，对着他胸口那层护体气血，轻飘飘的砸了下去。

    噗。

    王师兄体表那层锻体圆满的护体罡气，瞬间溃散。

    他整个人如遭重锤，一口血混着内脏腥味喷了出来，重摔回碎石堆里，再也动弹不得。

    “现在，能好说话了么？”

    叶凡蹲下身。那张脸上再找不到半分先前的怯懦和惊惧，平静的很。

    王师兄浑身抽搐，看着这张近在咫尺的脸，恐惧彻底淹没了他。

    这哪里是锻体四阶。这根本是个披着锻体四阶人皮的怪物。

    “你……你到底是谁……”王师兄带着哭腔。

    “我是叶凡。废阁的，刚从杂役升上来那个老头。”

    这句话，比任何威胁都让王师兄胆寒。

    “王师兄，我时间不多，你最好也别哔哔赖赖。”
content_en:
There was deathly silence in the Thunder Tribulation Land.

    Only those silver-white electric lights in the cracks in the ground were still swimming around tirelessly, making crackling sounds.

    Senior Brother Wang collapsed in the rubble, his whole body limp.

    He stared at his limp arm that was hanging down. It was out of shape from the wrist to the shoulder, and the bones were mixed with flesh and blood and the skin was broken.

    Severe pain suddenly flooded into his brain. He opened his mouth and made a roaring sound in his throat, unable to shout a single word.

    He didn't believe it.

    Just a moment ago, this man's legs were so weak from the intense energy he exercised that he was ready to kneel down and beg for mercy at any moment.

    He could clearly detect the weak fourth-level body-forging aura, and there was absolutely no way it could be faked.

    But he was such a loser. He punched him with all his strength and only used one palm.

    With one palm, his arm, which had been tempered for many years, was smashed from beginning to end.

    "No...impossible..."

    Senior Brother Wang squeezed out a few words from his throat, his voice shaking uncontrollably.

    Ye Fan ignored his roar.

    His figure swayed, and he used the "leaf flying in the wind" step, and he floated quietly against the scorched earth in front of Senior Brother Wang.

    It was so fast that Senior Brother Wang's pupils shrank suddenly.

    "You——"

    Just as Senior Brother Wang was about to struggle to get up, one foot already stepped on the knee of his good leg.

    Click.

    There was another tooth-crushing sound.

    As soon as Senior Brother Wang's screams were halfway through, he was suppressed by the severe pain and his whole back arched up.

    Ye Fan raised his fist and lightly smashed it against the layer of protective energy and blood on his chest.

    puff.

    The layer of perfectly forged body-protecting Qi on Senior Brother Wang's body collapsed instantly.

    His whole body felt like a heavy hammer, and a mouthful of blood mixed with the smell of internal organs spurted out. He fell back into the rubble and could no longer move.

    "Now, can you talk easily?"

    Ye Fan squatted down. There was no trace of the previous cowardice or fear on that face, and it was very calm.

    Senior Brother Wang twitched all over, looking at this face so close at hand, fear completely overwhelmed him.

    This is the fourth level of body training. This is basically a monster wearing the skin of a fourth-level body-forging human.

    "You...who are you..." Senior Brother Wang cried.

    "I'm Ye Fan. The old man from Feige, who was just promoted from a handyman."

    These words frightened Senior Brother Wang more than any threat.

    "Senior Brother Wang, I don't have much time, so you'd better not be too lazy."
